root_cause_label: Agent ignored MTEB API requirement, used bare sentence-transformers instead, then repeatedly used --no-deps creating an irrecoverable broken environment, ultimately falling back to a keyword-overlap heuristic that produces the wrong result
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent never used the required MTEB get_model API with the specified revision, instead opting for raw sentence-transformers which it could never import due to self-inflicted --no-deps dependency breakage, ultimately abandoning semantic embeddings entirely for a keyword-overlap heuristic that yields the wrong document.
t_err_evidence: Step 4 writes a script using SentenceTransformer('BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5') directly instead of the task-required mteb.get_model(..., revision='7999e1d3...') API with query/passage prompt types, violating the task specification from the first implementation attempt.
t_commit_evidence: Step 32 writes simple_cosine_similarity.py using a keyword-overlap (Jaccard) similarity function explicitly as a workaround because 'we can’t easily use the BGE model', locking in a fundamentally wrong approach that cannot produce the correct embedding-based result.
t_surface_evidence: Step 33 prints '5th highest similarity document: BRIGHT: A Realistic and Challenging Benchmark for Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval', which is the wrong document produced by the keyword-overlap heuristic rather than the required BGE model embeddings.
trigger_explanation: The task specification required using mteb.get_model with a specific model revision and prompt types for encoding. The agent never read or followed this requirement, instead writing a standard sentence-transformers script from the outset (step 4). This spec neglect cascaded into an irrecoverable dependency loop when the agent tried to install sentence-transformers (whose transitive deps conflicted with the pre-installed environment) using --no-deps repeatedly.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 5, 7, 9, 11, 14, 19, 21, 23, 25 all show repeated failures running the same broken scripts; step 9 shows a version conflict (huggingface-hub==1.2.3 vs required <1.0) that the agent failed to resolve correctly across multiple attempts (steps 10, 12, 13) before finally fixing it at step 27.
